title: ALPAC 1966 machine-translation report: near-term general scientific MT promise fails program audit
summary: The 1966 ALPAC report is promoted as the cube’s first program-audit negative-result record. The negative result is narrow and important: for the committee’s definition of useful machine translation of general scientific text without human translation or editing, the report said none existed and none was in immediate or predictable prospect. The same report preserved support for computational linguistics, objective evaluation, machine aids, and translation-process improvement, so the record is not encoded as “language computation failed.”
